## Findings

### Blocking

- [BLOCKING] The new handover string check accepts marker paths without confinement to the rotation directory; archive paths are also unchecked. Reproduced: resuming a modified ready marker deletes a file outside the project, and resuming a claimed marker with an external archive path overwrites that file. Validate both paths against their expected project-local locations before reading, writing or deleting. (original severity: error)
- [BLOCKING] The new `os.unlink(path)` unconditionally deletes the origin handover after delivery. During manual resume, the origin can write and mark a newer handover between the initial read and cleanup. Reproduced: cleanup deletes the newer content, leaves its ready marker pointing to a missing file, and archives only the older content. Coordinate cleanup with marker updates and preserve any handover that no longer belongs to the claimed version. (original severity: error)

### Advisory

- ADR-005: `os.rename(source, target)` claims the handover and prevents subsequent automatic delivery before any canonical NDJSON record exists. Injection logging occurs only later, after archiving. A failure between claim and logging therefore leaves an unrecorded rotation decision; this is not merely a reconstructible cache update. Record the claim decision before the rename and subsequent derived writes. (severity: warning)
